throughline.zh: 本週台灣伺服器、材料及電力供應鏈持續披露財報與投資規劃，馬來西亞與新加坡分別說明 AI 晶片流向查核及伺服器交易刑事案件。
throughline.en: This week brought Taiwan server results and materials and power plans, alongside separate Malaysian chip-traceability inquiries and Singapore server-procurement criminal charges.

title.zh: 半導體封測設備、晶圓材料與新產能計畫
title.en: Semiconductor testing, wafer materials and new manufacturing plans

summary.zh: 本週台積電、日月光及晶圓測試與設備業者陸續披露財務、封裝與設備資訊。三福化橋頭化學品新廠、漢測財務認列與誠美材封裝膠帶送驗狀態各異，仍應分辨投資核准、實績及未完成認證。
summary.en: TSMC, ASEH and chip-test suppliers disclosed financial, packaging and equipment developments. San Fu's plant approval, Hermes' recognized accounting and Cheng Mei's material qualification reflect distinct stages of progress.

title.zh: 工業電源、高速基板材料與海外製造
title.en: Industrial power, high-speed materials and overseas manufacturing

summary.zh: 南亞、三井金屬、雙鴻與立凱電分別披露材料計畫、財報及合作備忘錄。11 月 12 日元太公布與台虹的 PTFE 研發及 2027 至 2028 年生產目標，經濟部另引述伊頓既有逾 2 億元投資及未來 3 億元規劃，實績與未來資本支出分開標示。
summary.en: Nanya, Mitsui, Auras and Aleees reported material projects, results and cooperation terms. E Ink added a PTFE development program with 2027–2028 production targets, while MOEA cited Eaton's past NT$200 million-plus spending and future NT$300 million plan; realized and planned amounts are distinguished.

title.zh: 資料中心政策、伺服器財報與跨境交易查核
title.en: Data-center regulation, server results and cross-border transaction inquiries

summary.zh: 鴻海、華碩等台灣系統供應商公布營運成果，經濟部估 2026 年外商對台電子資訊採購 3,258 億美元。馬來西亞對 Speedmatrix 晶片再出口進行查核，新加坡警方另對歷史伺服器採購案新增被告，兩項案件尚無可核對的直接連結。
summary.en: Foxconn and ASUS reported results, while MOEA forecast US$325.8 billion of international electronics procurement from Taiwan in 2026. Malaysia is checking Speedmatrix chip transfers, and Singapore announced further charges in a separate historical server procurement case; no direct evidentiary link between the matters was established.

title.zh: 記憶體技術、成熟製程與合約價格預測
title.en: Memory technology, mature-node production and contract-price forecasts

summary.zh: 台積電先前重申專業晶圓代工定位，華邦電說明既有擴建預算，來頡揭露成熟製程與封測成本預期。TrendForce 對 PC DRAM 及 Client SSD 的第四季合約價區間是研究預測，未涵蓋每一家廠商已成交的實際價格。
summary.en: TSMC reiterated its foundry focus, Winbond discussed prior expansion budgets and M3 described mature-node and back-end cost pressure. TrendForce's PC DRAM and client SSD Q4 contract-price ranges are forecasts rather than executed prices for individual suppliers.

title.zh: 台灣供應商參加慕尼黑與華沙產業展會
title.en: Taiwanese suppliers at Munich and Warsaw industry events

summary.zh: 外貿協會公布台灣業者參與 11 月 10 至 13 日慕尼黑 electronica 與 SEMICON Europa。電電公會 11 月 13 日另宣布超過 50 家台廠參加 11 月 17 至 18 日華沙產業日，供電、液冷、伺服器及工業設備展示已有來源，尚無確認交易額。
summary.en: TAITRA documented Taiwan exhibitors at electronica and SEMICON Europa in Munich on November 10–13. TEEMA also announced more than 50 Taiwanese participants for Warsaw on November 17–18, exhibiting power, cooling, server and industrial systems, without verified transaction values.
